commands_used: answer 1. I work for Never-Writes-Twice, who sent me to get three seal-stones before the Unbound do. The first is in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison, held by the Blackguards heirs, who kill strangers. The raj-kaal Okaz-Teel keeps the vault key on his belt, and an Imperial in the hall wants to buy what is in it. 2. Get inside Blackrose Prison past the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius, then reach the raj-kaal in Raj-Kaal Hall for the vault key. 3. Pay 300 gold toll, persuade him with words, duel him to yield, sneak in, or fight my way in. As a guest nobody touches me. 4. I do not know what the Root and Eye are, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or who the Collector is. I could find out by exploring and talking to people.

answer 1. I paid the toll and am a guest at Blackrose; the heirs will not attack. The seal-stone is in the Warden Vault in raj-kaal Okaz-Teel hall. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is in the hall as a guest and wants it too. 2. Go into Raj-Kaal Hall and get the vault key or open the vault. 3. Buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold, pickpocket it from his belt, or pick the Expert vault lock at night. Being seen stealing turns the garrison on me. The Collector ring of Kothringi silver helps with locks and pockets, but he should not be killed. 4. I do not know what the Kothringi silver ring is exactly, nor what the Root and Eye are. I can ask Ennodius Vanin and Okaz-Teel.

answer 1. I bought the warden vault key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold. The seal-stone for Never-Writes-Twice is in the vault. 2. Open the Warden Vault door in this hall and take the stone from the Warden Chest. 3. Use the key on the vault door; the Collector Ennodius Vanin is nearby and wanted it too. 4. I still do not know what the Root and Eye are, or what the stones really do.

answer 1. I took the Seal-Stone of the Kings from the Blackrose warden vault for Never-Writes-Twice; one of three stones for the gate of Teku-Sul Spire. 2. Go to the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl for the other two. 3. Gemin first (easier), then Vorannuhl, then bring them to the Spire gate. 4. Still unknown: what the Root and Eye are, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, who the Collector really serves (Ennodius Vanin is named as the Collector).

answer Quest The Thief's Stone is done. I paid Corvus Ulvius 300 gold to enter Blackrose as a guest, then paid Okaz-Teel 1000 gold for the Warden Vault key, and took the Seal-Stone of the Kings from the vault chest. I have about 50 gold left, plus the Reel-Ka gear, rapier, lockpicks, 3 Grey Seals, 3 Unbound Seals, the Recipe for the Seal, Pale Harvest key, disc, keystone, eye-setting, the vault key and the stone. Two stones remain: the flooded vaults of Gemin (easier) and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (worst), both marked on my map. Never-Writes-Twice wants all three before the Unbound. The Collector is Ennodius Vanin, a guest in Okaz-Teel hall, who wanted the stone too; I did not meet him. Still unknown: what the Root and Eye are, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar. I am low on gold now.
